name: io.github.Servosity/exchange-online-mcp
title: Microsoft Exchange Online MCP
description: Exchange Online admin for MSPs: forwarding audits, EWS posture and offboarding, no PowerShell

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_ONLINE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the EXCHANGE_ONLINE_TOKEN credential for the Microsoft Exchange Online MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_ONLINE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank to use https://outlook.office365.com. Set it only for a national cloud or a test server; the token then goes to that host.

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_ONLINE_ANCHOR_MAILBOX
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The X-AnchorMailbox value for calls with no target mailbox, for example UPN:admin@example.com with a delegated token. Leave blank to use the organization system mailbox Microsoft documents for app-only calls.

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_ONLINE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to keep only read tools: exchange-online_read still serves the Get-* cmdlets, and every write tool is removed.

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_ONLINE_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to stop saving reads locally; reads go to the API. An inbox-rule sweep or quarantine snapshot you run is still saved.

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_ONLINE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_ONLINE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Exchange requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank; each call names its tenant ID.
